description_en: Personalized text-to-image: Create image inference tasks using a pre-trained model
description_zh: 个性化文生图/基于一个预训练模型创建图片推理任务
name: PersonalizedTextToImageAddInferenceJob

parameters.help_en: An array containing one or more image URLs. For example, `["url_1", "url_2", ...]`
parameters.help_zh: 包含图片链接的列表, 可包含单张或多张图片的链接, 如["url_1", "url_2", ...]
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The number of training steps for the model
parameters.help_zh: 模型训练任务训练步骤
parameters.name: train_steps

parameters.help_en: The English prompt for image generation. Use the placeholder for the subject. For example, change "a man in the snow" to "a in the snow"
parameters.help_zh: 英文prompt描述生成的图像, 要生成的角色用<special-token>替代, 如“a man in the snow”要改为"a <special-token> in the snow", "a photo of a girl"改为"a photo of a <special-token>"
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.help_en: The number of images to generate. Note: The maximum is 10 images per request in the test environment. If the value exceeds 10, it is treated as 10
parameters.help_zh: 要生成图片的数量。注意: 由于测试环境资源限制，一次最多生成10张图片, 该值大于10按10处理
parameters.name: image_number

parameters.help_en: A random seed to ensure reproducible image generation. The value must be within `[-1, 2147483647]`. If the value is outside this range or omitted, the system automatically generates a seed
parameters.help_zh: 随机数种子，该种子固定时可以得到相同的生成图像，确保结果的可复现性，注意: 输入值需处于[-1, 2147483647]，输入值在该区间外或者不输入时将自动生成一个合适的种子
parameters.name: seed

parameters.help_en:
Determines the influence of the reference image.
Valid values: `0.3`, `0.4`, `0.5`, `0.6`, `0.7`, and `0.8`.
A lower value decreases the influence of the reference image and increases the influence of the text prompt.
The default is `0.5`, and you typically do not need to change this value
parameters.help_zh:
表示输入的参考图像对生成过程的影响强度，
取值范围是 [0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8]，
值越小，表示参考图像对生成的影响强度越低，相应的，文本对生成过程的影响强度越高。
默认是0.5，一般情况不需要设置，保持默认
parameters.name: strength
